resources.string: Reconnect when the underlying network changes. Keep TUN active while waiting for a network. Explicit disconnect and revoked VPN permission stop reconnection.
Waiting for a network · VPN traffic remains captured

Android maintains the foreground VPN notification. Recent tasks now show the dashboard. If your system stops the service, review its battery settings or enable always-on VPN in Android settings. Lockdown can block traffic while VPN is unavailable.
